name: @pipeworx/mcp-peeringdb

tools.name: search_networks
tools.description: Look up networks in PeeringDB by name or ASN. Returns peering policy (Open/Selective/Restrictive), traffic level, info type (Content/NSP/ISP/Enterprise), scope, and IPv4/IPv6 prefix counts. Provide a name query or an ASN. Keyless.

query.description: Network name (matches names containing this text).

asn.description: Autonomous System Number, e.g. 15169 for Google.

tools.name: search_exchanges
tools.description: Find internet exchanges (IXes) in PeeringDB by name, city, or country (2-letter code). Returns the IX name, location, continent region, member network count, and website. Provide at least one of query/city/country. Keyless.

query.description: IX name (matches names containing this text).

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. US, DE, GB.

tools.name: search_facilities
tools.description: Find colocation facilities (data centers) in PeeringDB by name, city, or country (2-letter code). Returns the facility name, location, network count, street address, and website. Provide at least one of query/city/country. Keyless.

query.description: Facility name (matches names containing this text).

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. US, DE, GB.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-peeringdb forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the peeringdb pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
